confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels, not from live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately confident. Alcohol prices (beer, cocktail, wine) are less certain because of Malaysian alcohol taxes and venue variation; cocktail and wine are bounded against the beer anchor. Hotel anchors vary widely by district and season. The FX observation comes from search-result snippets attributed to the RBA exchange rates page, not from a directly read RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian mid-range urban benchmark, calibrated against Bangkok and Penang price levels for food, hostels and mid-tier hotels. Alcohol is priced higher than neighbouring countries because of Malaysian excise duties.
